svt_mipi_dsi_host_base_sequence Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_host_base_sequence:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This sequence raises/drops objections in the pre/post_start so that root sequences raise objections but subsequences do not.

  function bit
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_base_sequence::is_applicable
 (  svt_configuration cfg  ) 

Determines if this sequence can reasonably be expected to function correctly on the supplied cfg object. Base class currently implemented to generate an error and return '0'. The implication of this is that extended classes must implement the method and must not call the base class.

cfg - The svt_configuration to examine for applicability.

Return values - Returns '1' if sequence is applicable, '0' otherwise.
